mechanisms.behavior: Each struck target drops and its scoring state remains set until the reset output lifts the group. The isolated Ten target and two Jacks are separated on the playfield and share solenoid 6; do not model them as three adjacent targets. Factory reset linkage, pulse duration, jam behavior and power-on physical state remain unverified.
mechanisms.label: Ten and Jacks Shared Reset Group

mechanisms.label: Queens Three-Target Bank

mechanisms.behavior: Drain_Hit adds the ball to cvpmBallStack.InitNoTrough, which supplies switch 66 until solenoid 1 serves through the BallRelease proxy. This is an occupied ball state, not a coil-to-switch electrical relationship. Recreate the manual shooter lane and passive plunger separately; ejection tuning belongs to the table. Physical eject path, sensor position and timing remain unverified.
mechanisms.label: Single-Ball Outhole and Serve

mechanisms.behavior: Two pops share CPU score input 10. The single powered left kicking rubber shares score input 40 with passive contacts. Three flippers are cabinet-button switched, with the top flipper tied to the right button. They are not additional numbered solenoid drivers; use physical/table behavior and synthetic flipper states as documented. Direct power contacts, EOS wiring and exact assemblies require the primary schematic.
mechanisms.label: Directly Switched Pops, Kicking Rubber and Flippers
